0022600190.text: The Brooklyn Nets (2-6, 13th in the East, 5 games back in the Atlantic) visit the Atlanta Hawks (6-4, 1st in the Southeast, 4th in the East) on the road, with the Nets on a one-game winning streak and the Hawks on three straight wins. Brooklyn is missing Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain), and Noah Clowney is day-to-day with an illness and a game-time decision. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee), Jalen Johnson (ankle), Jock Landale (hip), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while Asa Newell (toe) and Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Nets lost 0-4 to the Hawks in 2025-26, including a 141-107 loss in Brooklyn on April 3, 2026.
